preconditions.description: The number of students n is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i < n for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each a_i is a non-negative integer less than n, representing the number of handshakes for the i-th student.

postconditions.description: If a valid order exists, the output is 'Possible' followed by a permutation of student indices (1-based) of length n. Otherwise, the output is 'Impossible'.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= student_id <= n for student_id in permutation) if 'Possible' in stdout else True
postconditions.description: If 'Possible' is printed, the permutation contains student indices from 1 to n exactly once.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i < len(present_before) for i, a_i in enumerate(a)) if 'Possible' in stdout else True
postconditions.description: For each student in the permutation, the number of handshakes a_i equals the number of students present before them who are not part of any team at the time of their arrival.

postconditions.expression: all(team_size == 3 for team in teams) if 'Possible' in stdout else True
postconditions.description: If teams are formed, each team consists of exactly three students.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(team)) == 3 for team in teams) if 'Possible' in stdout else True
postconditions.description: Each team consists of three distinct students.

postconditions.expression: all(not any(student in other_team for other_team in teams if other_team != team) for team in teams) if 'Possible' in stdout else True
postconditions.description: No student is part of more than one team.
